pivHint: The earth's TILT creates seasons - but if an argument has a TILT, it is said to have a ______ or bias.
winText: A subtle bias. TILT was the pivot - earth's axis to a SLANTed view.
lossText: SLANT - a biased angle. TILT was the pivot: earth's TILT to a SLANTed argument.
